Throwaway PPK keys, generated by `puttygen` purely so `ppk.rs` has something
real to convert. They open nothing: no host has ever seen the public halves.

Each `.ppk` has a `.pub` beside it, which is puttygen's own
`-O public-openssh` export of the same key. That is the oracle the tests
check against, so a conversion is only correct if it reproduces the public
key PuTTY says the file holds.

Covered between them: v2 and v3, ED25519, RSA and ECDSA P-256, unencrypted
and aes256-cbc. The encrypted pair use the passphrase in `PASSPHRASE`.
